purpose: Provide a read-only explained field guide of generalized mini-prompts for AI-assisted coding with KANDA Reasoner.
display_lines: Kanda Phrasebook contains 310 generalized mini-prompts for AI-assisted coding.
Every mini-prompt includes a plain-English explanation for non-programmer users.
The guide preserves Tool versus Project boundaries, Box Logic, NO_LEAK, Brick Wall, validation, Freeze, and Error Memory rules.
Use the smallest matching mini-prompt to restore the missing AI behavior.
The Phrasebook is read-only and does not edit prompts, source code, or project memory.
